verdict.reasons: Core defect: The requested technical evidence was not rendered. The article image shows an installed black supply pipe with a connector (resembling a hose pipe) but completely omits the 20cm drip tape and the 'ribbed compression union' requested in the image QA feedback. Consequently, the packaging is used as supporting infrastructure (the pipe) rather than the primary focus of an installation inspection. While the product roll itself is correctly identified as tape20 with authentic branding, the technical evidence mismatch makes it unsuitable for the specific installation title.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black installed irrigation line passes closely behind the right flank of the AFP package and reappears in the foreground on the same axis; because this continuous line connects behind the base, the complete footprint is not separated by an uninterrupted soil gap, so line_touches_or_crosses_package=true and clear_soil_gap=false. The white-and-blue AFP carton contains the one permitted roll, and no distinct loose uninstalled coil is visible outside it, so extra_loose_product_coil=false. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail protrudes from the sides or base of the package, so package_has_protruding_strip=false.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
